name: style1-medical-conference

page_rules.cover: Deep medical-blue background with a restrained cyan orbital or wave decoration; large clear title; no borrowed logo or wording.
page_rules.content: White background, #003399 title, #EAF4FF panels, #93C5F5 borders, and a low-opacity #20A7D8 lower-left wave. Do not introduce a dark or gray content-page background.
page_rules.section: White or very pale-blue content field with the same #003399 title system and #20A7D8 decorative wave; preserve source content density.

rules: Use these color roles exactly across every compatible page; do not choose a new blue, cyan, gray, or card fill per slide.
Reference images may provide only palette, typography character, spacing rhythm, borders, shadows, and non-semantic decoration.
Reference images must not contribute charts, pies, diagrams, tables, data panels, photos, icons, logos, text, or page layouts.
The source page alone defines every information-bearing visual object and its count.
